tree_boundary: Uncommitted environment/SlotCache, textured-hit/shadow and sky/perf work followed by exact depth reuse; no full Bevy displacement or moving-frame speedup claim
scope: Retain existing native raster shadow-atlas depth only for unchanged inputs; no quality, geometry, resolution, filter, cover, cadence or backend change
motivation: Native hardware timestamp captures before caching reported a 6.48-6.56 ms median static atlas interval in the 349-tile X15 preview; see native-sky-performance-2026-10-17.json for per-control data and boundaries

contracts.owner: Existing TerrainRenderer caches the existing atlas's depth revision and optional MeshRenderer source-buffer identity/instance revision; no second scheduler/backend or new dependency
contracts.light_key: Exact generated light matrices and source-activity flags, not intensity or ambient. Changed matrix/activity increments depth revision; unchanged data avoids atlas-uniform writes
contracts.terrain_invalidation: Successful camera-origin changes, dirty height pages, anchor/slot/membership changes and retirements. Identical partition publications preserve depth; invalid requests do not mutate the cache
contracts.mesh_key: Immutable renderer source identified by its instance-buffer handle; exact camera-relative instance bytes and per-primitive draw ranges change the revision, including motion, range clearing and instance removal
contracts.storage: One prior instance-byte vector only for shadow-casting meshes; 64 bytes per actual instance, bounded by the existing 65536-instance constructor limit. No vertex/source copy; disabled shadows allocate no vector storage or atlas
contracts.reuse: First/new inputs render every active layer; exact matches skip all atlas depth passes. No approximate hash, epsilon or update timer. Projection/view orientation/exposure alone do not change caster depth
contracts.submission: Existing ordered-submit contract: encoders that mark rendered depth must be submitted before receivers. External source/atlas mutation must invalidate the owner. invalidate_shadows() provides an explicit diagnostic/external invalidation control, not a new graphics mode
contracts.telemetry: shadow_active_layers counts potential active layers; shadow_rendered_passes reports actual last encoded depth passes. RT shadow queries are not cached or replaced

oracles.identity: Cached versus forced-redraw receiver frames must be byte-identical, not a perceptual threshold
cases: Repeated identical instance/range uploads and no-op terrain partition retain depth
Mesh motion, per-primitive range clearing and replacement source at the same instance revision refresh depth
Camera origin at zero and astronomical coordinates, stellar direction and source deactivation refresh depth
Dirty height-page update and retirement refresh depth; removed caster no longer shadows the receiver
oracles.fixed_source: cargo test --release -p thessa-render-wgpu --test surface_lighting fixed_source_shadow_frame_cost -- --ignored --nocapture; 1024 patches,64 mesh instances,1280x720,30 warmup+120 measured per run,three forced/cached pairs plus a disabled control. Same enabled settings and exact output image; all image readbacks/setup/source publication outside the timer
oracles.timing_boundary: CPU encode/submit + GPU completion for the fixed-source comparison; native perf captures separately provide coarse hardware GPU command intervals. No invented CPU-derived GPU time

reproduction.config: version=1,preset=high,renderer.surface_quality=high,renderer.specular_reflections=true,renderer.ray_tracing=local,shadows.enabled=true. RT-off changes ray_tracing to off; shadow-only disables specular reflections instead. Other fields inherit the shared preset/schema

final_verification.acceptance_limits: No cross-platform runtime, blind preference or whole-renderer production-parity acceptance

limitations: Benefits require unchanged caster/depth inputs; moving camera/origin, light, mesh or terrain refreshes depth conservatively
No layer-by-layer damage tracking or asynchronous cache scheduler
RT shadow/reflection costs, atlas off-cover residency and RT terrain/ocean membership remain unsolved by this optimization
Raw native before/after captures are sequential measurements, not a controlled same-process cache-toggle comparison; the fixed-source forced/cached diagnostic is that control
No isolated upload/publication-clone cost, cross-platform runtime validation, blind aesthetic acceptance or whole-renderer/Bevy parity claim
